    INSGNSSLooselyCoupledKalmanFilteredEstimatorTest.createFixture()

    private static void
    INSGNSSLooselyCoupledKalmanFilteredEstimatorTest.assertFirstFix(INSGNSSLooselyCoupledKalmanFilteredEstimator estimator, INSGNSSLooselyCoupledKalmanFilteredEstimatorTest.Fixture fixture, double timeSeconds, com.irurueta.navigation.frames.CoordinateTransformation expectedC)
    Asserts the outcome of the first GNSS measurements provided to an estimator: measurements are kept, the least squares fix is the true position and velocity, a Kalman filter epoch has been run at the timestamp of the measurements, and the INS solution has been initialised with the fix while keeping the expected attitude.
    private INSGNSSLooselyCoupledKalmanFilteredEstimatorTest.IntegratedSample
    INSGNSSLooselyCoupledKalmanFilteredEstimatorTest.assertUpdateBodyKinematicsIntegratesSample(INSGNSSLooselyCoupledKalmanFilteredEstimatorTest.Fixture fixture, BodyKinematics kinematics)
    Checks the behaviour of body kinematics updates after a first GNSS fix: the first sample only sets the time reference (no navigation), a repeated timestamp is ignored, and the second sample is integrated with the ECEF inertial navigation equations over the elapsed interval, without running any Kalman filter epoch nor modifying the GNSS estimation.
